name: Second Humanity
source:
"Excellence has a price... and your mind is the currency." On the surface, Second Humanity seems like the ultimate school drama in a prestigious Colombian academy. As the new student in Class 02, you are surrounded by prodigies: the conciliatory Eva, the provocative Caelum, and the spectral Isoria. But beneath the marble walls of Humanity School lies a dystopia where survival depends on your ability to exploit the weaknesses of others—or perhaps, finally understand who 'They' truly are.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4282000/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“卓越是有代价的……而你的思想就是货币。”从表面上看，《第二人类》似乎是哥伦比亚一所著名学院的终极校园戏剧。作为02班的新生，你周围都是天才：和解的伊娃、挑衅的凯鲁姆和幽灵般的伊索里亚。但在人类学校的大理石墙下，隐藏着一个反乌托邦，在这里，生存取决于你利用他人弱点的能力——或者也许最终了解“他们”的真实身份。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4282000/]Steam[/url]]
